philosophies.name: The Improver
philosophies.tagline: Nature shipped a draft. I am the editor.
philosophies.blurb: You are not doing anything strange. You are doing proofreading, with a scalpel, on a species.

monologue.intro: {rival}. Good. I have been meaning to have a look at your work — it has a great deal of promise and a great many typos.
monologue.victory: Corrections applied. {rival}, I would suggest a second pass, but I have taken the specimen you would need for it.
monologue.defeat: Noted, filed, and underlined twice. {rival}, that was version one. You will not enjoy version two.
monologue.conquest: {node} is now under revision. Nothing has been destroyed. Several things have been IMPROVED, which locals may find more alarming.
capture: The {creature} is coming home for a second opinion. It will not be a kind one, but it will be thorough.
The {creature} has been referred for improvement. It did not ask to be.
The {creature} is coming back to the lab. There is so much we can do.
The {creature} will be better by Thursday. It does not know that yet.
The {creature} arrives for assessment. The assessment is a formality; the plan is already drawn.
The {creature} is a first draft and I am a generous editor.
The {creature} joins the programme. Version two begins tonight.
The {creature} is coming with us. We will only change what is wrong, which is most of it.
The {creature} is salvageable. Everything is salvageable, with enough enthusiasm.
The {creature} has potential, and potential is just an appointment nobody has kept yet.
monologue.rehab: {creature} came to us badly annotated. Six hours of patient work later, it is legible.
monologue.graduation: {creature} leaves the programme with a clean bibliography and, at last, a straight spine.
monologue.dominion: Every node in the county, revised. I am told this is called winning; I would call it a first edition. The corrections continue.
monologue.gauntlet: {creature}, annotated, corrected, and returned to sender. The coalition's masterpiece needed a second draft. It got one.

philosophies.name: The Collector
philosophies.tagline: Every animal is a part I do not have yet.
philosophies.blurb: You love them all. That is precisely the problem, and the county has begun to notice.

monologue.intro: Oh, {rival}, you have brought me PRESENTS. You did not have to. You did not, in fairness, agree to.
monologue.victory: Catalogued. {rival}, do bring the rest of the set next time — I am three specimens off a complete row.
monologue.defeat: You kept them. Fine. I know where they live now, {rival}, and I am extremely patient.
monologue.conquest: {node} acquired. Everything in it is also, by a definition I invented, acquired.
capture: The {creature}! I have wanted one of those since page forty of the catalogue.
The {creature} completes a row. You cannot imagine how long that row has been incomplete.
The {creature} is mine. It is catalogued, it is labelled, it is HOME.
The {creature} goes in the good cabinet. Yes, that one.
The {creature}! Somebody fetch the index cards.
The {creature} joins the collection and immediately improves it.
The {creature} has been acquired. The word acquired is doing some work there.
The {creature} is the one I did not have. Now I have it.
The {creature} is exactly the specimen the shelf has been waiting for.
The {creature}. Finally. The gap has been bothering me for months.
monologue.rehab: {creature} is not a prisoner. {creature} is an ACQUISITION, and acquisitions get the good enclosure.
monologue.graduation: {creature} has been added to the collection and, more importantly, has stopped trying to leave it.
monologue.dominion: The whole county, catalogued and shelved. There are gaps, of course. There are always gaps. That is what makes it a collection.
monologue.gauntlet: {creature}. Signed, dated, witnessed, and entered into the permanent collection under 'Theirs, Formerly'.

philosophies.name: The Showman
philosophies.tagline: Science is a spectacle or it is a filing cabinet.
philosophies.blurb: The work is excellent. The lighting is better. You have never once made an entrance through a door.

monologue.intro: Ladies, gentlemen, and {rival} — tonight, for one night only, in this actual field: the future of animals.
monologue.victory: AND SCENE. Thank you, {rival}, you were a wonderful sport and a magnificent volunteer.
monologue.defeat: A soft opening! Merely a soft opening, {rival}. The reviews will be kinder once I fix the second act.
monologue.conquest: {node} taken to rapturous applause from an audience of me and one very confused postman.
capture: The {creature} joins the company! Standing ovation, no notes, someone find it a hat.
The {creature} is a headliner and does not know it yet.
The {creature} has star quality. The star quality is mostly teeth.
The {creature} signs on! Billing to be negotiated, loudly.
The {creature} is going to bring the house down. Possibly literally.
The {creature} is booked. Opening night is whenever it stops sulking.
The {creature} has presence. That is not a compliment you can teach.
The {creature} joins the bill and immediately demands a better dressing pen.
The {creature} is coming with us and the crowd does not know how lucky it is.
The {creature}! Lights. Hay. Action.
monologue.rehab: {creature} arrives from a rival production. We do not poach. We AUDITION, retroactively.
monologue.graduation: {creature} takes its first bow to enormous applause. Some of it was even from outside the building.
monologue.dominion: The county is MINE, and I want it on record that nobody watched the middle bit. Doesn't matter. Curtain up on the encore.
monologue.gauntlet: AND FOR MY NEXT TRICK — {creature}, ladies and gentlemen! They built it in secret and I beat it in public!

philosophies.name: The Naturalist
philosophies.tagline: I am not playing god. God simply left the door open.
philosophies.blurb: You speak softly, you love the countryside, and you have made several things that live in it now.

monologue.intro: Hello, {rival}. Isn't it a lovely morning. I have brought some friends who would very much like to meet you.
monologue.victory: There now. {rival}, nothing was hurt that will not walk it off, and everything learned a great deal.
monologue.defeat: That's quite all right. {rival}, the countryside is very patient, and so, it turns out, am I.
monologue.conquest: {node} has been returned to nature. A nature I designed, admittedly, but the birdsong is genuine.
capture: The {creature} is coming to live with us. It will have a pond. It has earned a pond.
The {creature} is coming home to somewhere with better weather and worse fencing.
The {creature} deserved better than where it was. It has better now.
The {creature} joins us. There is a warm corner already picked out.
The {creature} is out of that place and into a field. That is the whole plan.
The {creature} will be happier here. Most things are.
The {creature} comes home. Somebody has already made it a nest it did not ask for.
The {creature} is ours to look after now, which is a promise rather than a boast.
The {creature} arrives. It will be fed too much within the hour.
The {creature} is safe, fed, and being talked to in a silly voice.
monologue.rehab: {creature} was raised in a laboratory and has never once seen a hedge. We shall be correcting that.
monologue.graduation: {creature} has settled in beautifully and now follows the feed bucket like anybody else.
monologue.dominion: The county has been returned to its natural state, which is to say mine. Nature does not stop, and neither, apparently, do they.
monologue.gauntlet: {creature} has been rewilded, in the sense that it is now scrap, and scrap is a habitat. Nature thanks you.

philosophies.name: The Engineer
philosophies.tagline: Feelings are fine. Tolerances are better.
philosophies.blurb: You did not set out to build monsters. You set out to build correctly, and this is where correctly leads.

monologue.intro: {rival}. Your specimens are within tolerance. Barely. I have brought mine, which are not merely within it but ANNOYED about the margin.
monologue.victory: Load tested to failure. Not mine. {rival}, your margins were optimistic and now they are documented.
monologue.defeat: Failure logged. Root cause identified. {rival}, the fix is scheduled and you are on the ticket.
monologue.conquest: {node} brought up to spec. Three inspections failed it last year. It will not fail mine.
capture: The {creature} is structurally interesting and is coming back to the shop.
The {creature} has a load path I would like to understand. It is coming with us.
The {creature} is a working prototype somebody abandoned. Not any more.
The {creature} is coming to the workshop. Tolerances will be checked.
The {creature} is well made. Well made things should be studied, then improved.
The {creature} joins the shop floor. Its geometry is frankly excellent.
The {creature} has an interesting joint and I intend to look at it.
The {creature} is coming home for measurement and, eventually, admiration.
The {creature} is sound. Sound is a good place to start from.
The {creature} is being requisitioned on engineering grounds. Those grounds are real.
monologue.rehab: {creature} was built to somebody else's spec. It is a good spec. It is not, however, MY spec.
monologue.graduation: {creature} passes final inspection. Torque correct, gait even, disposition acceptable.
monologue.dominion: All {nodes} nodes, load-bearing and mine. Tolerances hold. Note for the log: the coalition is a renewable input, not a solved problem.
monologue.gauntlet: {creature}: load tested to failure. Documenting the failure mode was a pleasure. It was 'me'.
